title: The Perils of Reporting on an Investigation of the President

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报《DealBook》的商业与政策报道记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: We begin the hour with a show-stopping report from BuzzFeed that, if true, could cost the president his job.
sentences.zh: 我们首先以 BuzzFeed 的一则震撼报道开启本小时的节目，如果属实，这可能会让总统丢掉工作。

sentences.en: The explosive report says the president personally instructed his longtime lawyer
sentences.zh: 这篇极具爆炸性的报道称，总统亲自指示他的长期律师

sentences.en: Michael Cohen to lie to Congress to hide the president's involvement in a real estate deal for a Moscow Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩向国会撒谎，以隐瞒总统对莫斯科特朗普大厦房地产交易的参与。

sentences.en: BuzzFeed cites two law enforcement officials who say Mueller has evidence that the president personally instructed Cohen to lie.
sentences.zh: BuzzFeed 援引两位执法官员的话称，穆勒掌握了总统亲自指示科恩撒谎的证据。

sentences.en: The story's most explosive and consequential claim is this, that according to BuzzFeed sources,
sentences.zh: 这篇报道中最具爆炸性和决定性的主张是，根据 BuzzFeed 消息来源的说法，

sentences.en: the special counsel's office learned about Trump's directive for Cohen to lie to Congress
sentences.zh: 特别检察官办公室是通过对特朗普集团多名证人的采访，以及公司内部电子邮件、短信和一批其他文件的采访，

sentences.en: through interviews with multiple witnesses from the Trump Organization and internal company emails, text messages, and a cache of other documents.
sentences.zh: 才得知特朗普关于要求科恩向国会撒谎的指示的。

sentences.en: It's the most direct allegation yet that President Trump may have committed a crime.
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止最直接的指控，表明特朗普总统可能已经犯罪。

sentences.en: Mike, what were you thinking when that BuzzFeed report first came out earlier this month?
sentences.zh: 迈克，本月早些时候那篇 BuzzFeed 报道刚出来时，你心里是怎么想的？

sentences.en: My first thought was, damn, that's a really good story.
sentences.zh: 我的第一个想法是，天哪，这真是一篇好报道。

sentences.en: And it particularly hurt because I have spent much of the past two years focused on the issue of obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 而且它尤其让我痛心，因为过去两年里我大部分时间都专注于妨碍司法公正的问题。

sentences.en: And this was the clearest case to date that showed the president may have obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止最清晰的案例，表明总统可能妨碍了司法公正。

sentences.en: It was the president telling one of his associates to lie.
sentences.zh: 这是总统在指示他的一个同伙撒谎。

sentences.en: If true, this would be bigger than water again.
sentences.zh: 如果属实，这将比水门事件还要大。

sentences.en: If true, this would be obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 如果属实，这就构成了妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: Well, the revelation is prompting Democrats to say impeachment is a possibility if the reports are true.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这一爆料正促使民主党人表示，如果报道属实，弹劾是有可能的。

sentences.en: If, if, if, if, if, if true.
sentences.zh: 如果、如果、如果、如果、如果，如果属实。

sentences.en: Then we are likely on our way to possible impeachment proceedings.
sentences.zh: 那么我们很可能正走向可能的弹劾程序。

sentences.en: Immediately, there was a lot of pressure on us to match the story.
sentences.zh: 瞬间，我们承受了巨大的压力去跟进这篇报道。

sentences.en: So far, we have not been able to confirm BuzzFeed's report.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们还没能证实 BuzzFeed 的报道。

sentences.en: And we spent much of the day trying to suss out what was going on.
sentences.zh: 我们花了一整天的时间试图弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: We should note CNN has not independently confirmed BuzzFeed's reporting, nor, for that matter, has anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我们应该指出，美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）尚未独立证实 BuzzFeed 的报道，其实其他人也没有。

sentences.en: And we got a fair amount of pushback and struggled to get it confirmed.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了相当多的阻力，并且在获得证实方面举步维艰。

sentences.en: MSNBC, NBC News couldn't confirm that information.
sentences.zh: MSNBC 和 NBC 新闻都无法证实这一消息。

sentences.en: If I run this information, it's not verified at the Washington PoSt.
sentences.zh: 如果我发布这条消息，它在《华盛顿邮报》并未得到核实。

sentences.en: We can't verify this information independently.
sentences.zh: 我们无法独立核实这一消息。

sentences.en: Not independently confirm these allegations.
sentences.zh: 无法独立证实这些指控。

sentences.en: No other news organization other than BuzzFeed has this story at this point.
sentences.zh: 除了 BuzzFeed 之外，目前没有其他新闻机构有这篇报道。

sentences.en: And by that evening, we saw something highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 到了那天晚上，我们看到了极其罕见的一幕。

sentences.en: And here is the breaking news, a rare and stunning move from the special counsel tonight.
sentences.zh: 以下是突发新闻，今晚特别检察官采取了一项罕见而惊人的举动。

sentences.en: Robert Mueller's team disputing an explosive BuzzFeed report, alleging the president told Michael Cohen to lie to Congress.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·穆勒的团队反驳了一篇指控总统指示迈克尔·科恩向国会撒谎的轰动性 BuzzFeed 报道。

sentences.en: The special counsel's office, which rarely speaks publicly, put out a statement knocking down the story.
sentences.zh: 极少公开表态的特别检察官办公室发表了一份声明，驳斥了这篇报道。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话如下：

sentences.en: BuzzFeed's description of specific statements to the special counsel's office and characterization of documents and testimony obtained by this office regarding Michael Cohen's congressional testimony are not accurate.
sentences.zh: “BuzzFeed 对特别检察官办公室特定陈述的描述，以及对本办公室就迈克尔·科恩国会证词所获得的文件和证词的定性，是不准确的。”

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Saying very forcefully and very clearly, something in this story is wrong.
sentences.zh: 非常有力且非常明确地指出，这篇报道里有地方弄错了。

sentences.en: This was a reporter's worst nightmare.
sentences.zh: 这是记者的终极噩梦。

sentences.en: This isn't a correction of the BuzzFeed story.
sentences.zh: 这不是对 BuzzFeed 报道的更正。

sentences.en: This is an annihilation of it.
sentences.zh: 这是对它的彻底粉碎。

sentences.en: And this is a bad one for BuzzFeed, man.
sentences.zh: 这对 BuzzFeed 来说可真是个灾难，伙计。

sentences.en: They maybe should have stuck to some cat listicles.
sentences.zh: 他们也许应该坚持做一些猫咪清单之类的东西。

sentences.en: It's not good.
sentences.zh: 这可真不妙。

sentences.en: The press is making itself look very, very badly.
sentences.zh: 新闻界把自己搞得非常非常难堪。

sentences.en: And it's going to be very difficult for this media to restore any credibility it once had before.
sentences.zh: 这家媒体将很难恢复它曾经拥有的任何信誉。

sentences.en: And I think the president...
sentences.zh: 而且我认为总统……

sentences.en: We have the special counsel, Bob Mueller, who probably has more credibility in Washington right now than anyone else, saying your story's not true.
sentences.zh: 我们有特别检察官鲍勃·穆勒，他在华盛顿的公信力可能比其他任何人都高，他说你们的报道不是真的。

sentences.en: So the people are saying heads should roll at BuzzFeed.
sentences.zh: 所以人们在说 BuzzFeed 应该有人被革职。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: That you're hurting the news business as a whole.
sentences.zh: 说你在损害整个新闻行业。

sentences.en: What do you say?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何回应？

sentences.en: I've been a reporter for 20 years.
sentences.zh: 我当了20年记者。

sentences.en: This is going to be borne out, Brian.
sentences.zh: 这件事会被证实是对的，布莱恩。

sentences.en: This story is accurate.
sentences.zh: 这篇报道是准确的。

sentences.en: It got me thinking of a time when a similar team of journalists found themselves in a very similar situation.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一段时光，当时一组类似的记者发现自己身处极其相似的境地。

sentences.en: You rolling?
sentences.zh: 你在录音吗？

sentences.en: So I got in an Uber and went to Georgetown.
sentences.zh: 于是我叫了一辆优步去了乔治城。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Mike Schmidt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是迈克·施密特。

sentences.en: Is Bob there?
sentences.zh: 鲍勃在吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I'm second.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是第二个。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: How are you, Dale?
sentences.zh: 戴尔，你好吗？

sentences.en: To the home of Bob Woodward.
sentences.zh: 来到鲍勃·伍德沃德的家。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》播客。

sentences.en: The Perils of Reporting on a Presidential Investigation.
sentences.zh: 报道总统调查的风险。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, January 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月31日，星期四。

sentences.en: One, two.
sentences.zh: 一，二。

sentences.en: One, two.
sentences.zh: 一，二。

sentences.zh: 这样可以吗？

sentences.en: We'll see if we can quiet the dog and the door on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我们看看能不能让狗安静下来，把电话上的门关上。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: It's the real world.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实世界。

sentences.en: It's the real Bob Woodward.
sentences.zh: 这就是真正的鲍勃·伍德沃德。

sentences.en: Well, the life of living with the dog.
sentences.zh: 这就是养狗的生活。

sentences.en: It's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: So, what's the story that Woodward told you?
sentences.zh: 那么，伍德沃德跟你讲了什么故事？

sentences.en: The story Woodward told me starts with the Watergate break-in in June of 1972.
sentences.zh: 伍德沃德讲的故事要从1972年6月的水门事件入室盗窃案说起。

sentences.en: The Democratic National Committee is trying to solve a spy mystery.
sentences.zh: 民主党全国委员会正试图解开一个间谍谜团。

sentences.en: It began before dawn Saturday when five intruders were captured by police inside the offices of the committee in Washington.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于周六黎明之前，当时有五名闯入者被警察抓获，地点在华盛顿该委员会的办公室里。

sentences.en: It was at 2.30 in the morning, and by 9 o'clock, the editors at the Post are getting on, you know, how are we going to cover this?
sentences.zh: 那是凌晨两点半，到了九点钟，《邮报》的编辑们就开始讨论，你知道的，我们要怎么报道这件事？

sentences.en: Five people have been arrested and charged with breaking into the headquarters of the Democratic National Committee in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 五个人被捕并被指控在半夜闯入民主党全国委员会总部。

sentences.en: Bob Woodward and his partner, Carl Bernstein, jumped on that story.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·伍德沃德和他的搭档卡尔·伯恩斯坦立刻介入了这篇报道。

sentences.en: I was sent to the courthouse and saw burglars in the business suits.
sentences.zh: 我被派去法院，看到盗贼们穿着商务西装。

sentences.en: It didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这说不通。

sentences.en: Lee burglar worked for the CIA.
sentences.zh: 其中一个盗贼为中情局工作。

sentences.en: So, there was an immediate curiosity.
sentences.zh: 所以，人们立刻感到了好奇。

sentences.en: In the weeks and months after the break-in, Woodward and Carl Bernstein are out front on this coverage.
sentences.zh: 在入室盗窃案发生后的几周和几个月里，伍德沃德和卡尔·伯恩斯坦一直在这次报道的最前沿。

sentences.en: One of the suspects, James McCord, operates his own security company in Washington.
sentences.zh: 其中一名嫌疑人詹姆斯·麦考德在华盛顿经营着他自己的保安公司。

sentences.en: He was doing work for the Republican National Committee and the Committee to re-elect President Nixon.
sentences.zh: 他一直在为共和党全国委员会和连任总统尼克松委员会工作。

sentences.en: No one has proved that the Republicans are behind the break-in, but tomorrow the Democrats are expected to file some sort of legal action against the GOP anyway.
sentences.zh: 没有人证明共和党人是入室盗窃案的幕后黑手，但无论如何，预计明天民主党人还是会向共和党发起某种法律诉讼。

sentences.en: Mr. Nixon, did you know about the burglary of our Democratic National Headquarters at the Watergate?
sentences.zh: 尼克松先生，你知道我们在水门大厦的民主党全国总部被盗一事吗？

sentences.en: They are doing everything possible to figure out ties between the burglars who broke into the Watergate and Nixon's campaign.
sentences.zh: 他们正在尽一切可能找出闯入水门大厦的盗贼与尼克松竞选团队之间的联系。

sentences.en: Conventional wisdom then was, Nixon's too smart to do this, but Carl and I didn't do conventional wisdom, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 当时大家的普遍看法是，尼克松太聪明了，不会干这种事，但老实说，我和卡尔不买传统看法的账。

sentences.en: And they kind of have the story all to themselves.
sentences.zh: 而且他们几乎把这个独家新闻全占了。

sentences.en: They are out front, even when some news organizations are ignoring it.
sentences.zh: 他们冲在最前面，甚至在一些新闻机构选择忽视它的时候。

sentences.en: Including the Times.
sentences.zh: 包括《时报》在内。

sentences.en: The Post was ahead.
sentences.zh: 《邮报》领先了。

sentences.en: Big time.
sentences.zh: 大大领先。

sentences.en: We started developing sources like the bookkeeper, who kept the records on the money, and the treasurer, Hughes Sloan.
sentences.zh: 我们开始发展线人，比如负责记账的记账员休·斯隆，以及司库。

sentences.en: And so it was always about money, or at least that was one path of exploration.
sentences.zh: 所以这总是关于金钱，或者至少那是探索的途径之一。

sentences.en: And they discover this slush fund, this pot of money that Nixon's advisors controlled,
sentences.zh: 他们发现了这个秘密金库，这是一笔由尼克松顾问控制的资金池，

sentences.en: so they could dole money out to folks like the burglars to do the dirty political deeds that they thought needed to happen as Nixon was running for re-election.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就可以把钱分发给像盗贼这样的人，去干那些他们认为在尼克松竞选连任时必须要做的政治脏活。

sentences.en: So we found out that John Mitchell, who'd been the attorney general, who'd been Nixon's campaign manager, controlled dispersal of the funds, so did Maurice Stans,
sentences.zh: 所以我们发现，曾任总检察长、尼克松竞选经理的约翰·米切尔控制着资金的分发，莫里斯·斯坦斯也是如此，

sentences.en: who was the treasurer.
sentences.zh: 他当时是司库。

sentences.en: As part of that coverage, Woodward and Bernstein were able to establish four people who had access to those funds.
sentences.zh: 作为报道的一部分，伍德沃德和伯恩斯坦查实了有四个人可以动用这些资金。

sentences.en: People very close to the president, including his campaign manager at the time.
sentences.zh: 非常接近总统的人，包括他当时的竞选经理。

sentences.en: So this reporting is starting to get closer and closer to President Nixon himself.
sentences.zh: 所以这篇报道开始越来越接近尼克松总统本人。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that October, Woodward and Bernstein thought they had a huge scoop.
sentences.zh: 就在那年10月，伍德沃德和伯恩斯坦认为他们得到了一个巨大的独家新闻。

sentences.en: All roads led to Haldeman, the White House chief of staff.
sentences.zh: 所有的线索都指向白宫幕僚长霍尔德曼。

sentences.en: That's H.R.
sentences.zh: 也就是 H.R.

sentences.en: Haldeman.
sentences.zh: 霍尔德曼。

sentences.en: H.R.
sentences.zh: H.R.

sentences.en: Bob Haldeman.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·霍尔德曼。

sentences.en: They had learned that H.R.
sentences.zh: 他们得知 H.R.

sentences.en: Haldeman, the person closest to the president, controlled the slush fund.
sentences.zh: 霍尔德曼，这位与总统最亲近的人，控制着那个秘密金库。

sentences.en: So we interviewed people, including Hugh Sloan, and he finally said it was Haldeman.
sentences.zh: 于是我们采访了包括休·斯隆在内的人，他最终确认那就是霍尔德曼。

sentences.en: And Hugh Sloan, the treasurer of Nixon's campaign, had testified about that to the grand jury investigating the president.
sentences.zh: 而尼克松竞选团队的司库休·斯隆曾在调查总统的大陪审团面前作证过这一点。

sentences.en: A big scoop.
sentences.zh: 一个重磅独家。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was the big story.
sentences.zh: 这就是那条重磅新闻。

sentences.en: If he was involved in this, if he could authorize money, that led right to Nixon's doorstep.
sentences.zh: 如果他卷入其中，如果他能批准资金，那就直接指向了尼克松的门前。

sentences.en: Because this would be the first person inside the White House at the time who was also controlling the funds from the slush fund.
sentences.zh: 因为这将是当时白宫内部第一个也控制着秘密金库资金的人。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 确切地说。

sentences.en: So they were reporting on this just weeks before the November election.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在11月大选前几周一直在报道这件事。

sentences.en: They have three sources confirming Haldeman's the guy.
sentences.zh: 他们有三个消息来源证实霍尔德曼就是那个人。

sentences.en: And on deadline, right before they're about to publish, their editor asked them to get another source.
sentences.zh: 在截稿期限前，就在他们即将发表报道之前，他们的编辑要求他们再找一个消息来源。

sentences.en: So Bernstein called a lawyer in the Justice Department and said, you know, we know it's Haldeman.
sentences.zh: 于是伯恩斯坦给司法部的一名律师打电话说，你知道的，我们知道那是霍尔德曼。

sentences.en: And the lawyer said, I'd like to help you.
sentences.zh: 那名律师说，我很想帮你们。

sentences.en: I really would.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想。

sentences.en: But I just can't say anything.
sentences.zh: 但我就是什么也不能说。

sentences.en: So Bernstein comes up with a workaround.
sentences.zh: 于是伯恩斯坦想出了一个变通的办法。

sentences.en: And he says to the official.
sentences.zh: 他对这位官员说。

sentences.en: He said, I'll count to 10.
sentences.zh: 他说，我数到10。

sentences.en: And if it's OK, tell me it's OK.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，就告诉我可以。

sentences.en: I'm going to count to 10.
sentences.zh: 我要数到10。

sentences.en: And if by the time I'm done counting, you haven't said anything, I'll know the story's true.
sentences.zh: 如果我数完的时候你什么都没说，我就知道这个故事是真的。

sentences.en: And this was done in a very clever but direct way.
sentences.zh: 这是用一种非常聪明但又直接的方式完成的。

sentences.en: So Bernstein starts counting.
sentences.zh: 于是伯恩斯坦开始数数。

sentences.en: And the lawyer said, you've got it straight now.
sentences.zh: 律师说，你现在把事情弄清楚了。

sentences.en: You've got it straight now.
sentences.zh: 你现在把事情弄清楚了。

sentences.en: Bernstein thanked him again and hung up.
sentences.zh: 伯恩斯坦再次向他致谢并挂断了电话。

sentences.en: He told me about it.
sentences.zh: 他跟我说起过这事。

sentences.en: We have a fourth source.
sentences.zh: 我们有第四个消息源。

sentences.en: They tell the editors and they publish.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉编辑，然后编辑发表。

sentences.en: So then what happens?
sentences.zh: 那接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: As they expected, the story lands with huge impact.
sentences.zh: 正如他们所料，这篇报道产生了巨大的轰动。

sentences.en: The story came out, lead story, and we feel quite comfortable.
sentences.zh: 报道发表了，作为头条新闻，我们感到非常踏实。

sentences.en: Everyone in Washington is buzzing about it.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿的每个人都在热烈讨论这件事。

sentences.en: It shows just how high the conspiracy went into the White House.
sentences.zh: 这表明这场阴谋渗透到了白宫多高的层级。

sentences.en: And Woodward and Bernstein are in the newsroom that day, basking in the glory of the story when...
sentences.zh: 那天伍德沃德和伯恩斯坦正坐在新闻编辑室里，沉浸在报道成功的荣耀中，这时……

sentences.en: A reporter at the Post, education reporter, Eric Wentworth, said, have you seen what happened on television?
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》的一名记者，教育记者埃里克·温特沃斯说，你们看电视上播出的内容了吗？

sentences.en: And we hadn't seen anything.
sentences.zh: 而我们什么都还没看到。

sentences.en: Did you guys just see what Hugh Sloan's lawyer said on television?
sentences.zh: 你们刚才看到休·斯隆的律师在电视上说的话了吗？

sentences.en: And what had Sloan's lawyer said?
sentences.zh: 斯隆的律师说了什么？

sentences.en: I assume you were referring to the testimony before the grand jury is reported in the Washington Post this morning.
sentences.zh: 我猜你指的是今天早上《华盛顿邮报》报道的大陪审团证词。

sentences.en: Sloan's lawyer, with Sloan standing right next to him...
sentences.zh: 斯隆的律师，旁边就站着斯隆本人……

sentences.en: Our answer to that is an unequivocal no.
sentences.zh: 我们对此的回应是毫无保留的否定。

sentences.en: Mr. Sloan did not implicate Mr. Haldeman in that testimony at all.
sentences.zh: 斯隆先生在证词中根本没有牵涉霍尔德曼先生。

sentences.en: ...had come out and knocked the story down.
sentences.zh: ……站出来把这篇报道给推翻了。

sentences.en: And Sloan's our source, and somebody we developed a close relationship with, as you know, with sources.
sentences.zh: 斯隆是我们的消息源，正如你们所知，我们与消息源建立起了密切的关系。

sentences.en: And it is agony.
sentences.zh: 这简直是一种煎熬。

sentences.en: Here you had his lawyer standing there on national television saying, the story's not true.
sentences.zh: 当时他的律师居然站在全国电视直播前说，这篇报道不是真的。

sentences.en: I can't describe the emotions, but they included, we're finished, we're going to have to resign.
sentences.zh: 我无法形容那种心情，但其中包括：我们完了，我们得辞职了。

sentences.en: It's the worst feeling as a journalist, right?
sentences.zh: 作为记者，这是最糟糕的感觉，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's, you have a sinking feeling that it's so intense you don't even know where your stomach is.
sentences.zh: 这种下沉的感觉如此强烈，你甚至不知道自己的胃在哪里。

sentences.en: You know it's somewhere in your body, and it's crying out really hard.
sentences.zh: 你知道它还在你的身体里某个地方，而且在痛苦地大声呼喊。

sentences.en: So what had actually happened?
sentences.zh: 那实际上到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Had they gotten anything wrong?
sentences.zh: 他们弄错了什么吗？

sentences.en: They didn't know.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道。

sentences.en: We were saying, well, we need to write some sort of story.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说，好吧，我们需要写一篇某种形式的报道。

sentences.en: We need to back down, or we need to explain.
sentences.zh: 我们需要退让，或者我们需要解释。

sentences.en: And then Bradley said, look, you're not even sure whether you got it right or wrong.
sentences.zh: 接着布拉德利说，听着，你们甚至不确定自己弄对还是弄错了。

sentences.en: What part is wrong?
sentences.zh: 哪部分错了？

sentences.en: You don't know where you are.
sentences.zh: 你们根本不知道自己的处境。

sentences.en: You haven't got the facts.
sentences.zh: 你们还没有掌握事实。

sentences.en: Hold your water for a while.
sentences.zh: 先别急，沉住气。

sentences.en: So Woodward called Sloan's lawyer.
sentences.zh: 于是伍德沃德给斯隆的律师打了电话。

sentences.en: He said, look, you don't have to apologize for this.
sentences.zh: 他说，听着，你不需要为此道歉。

sentences.en: And essentially, it's true.
sentences.zh: 而且从根本上说，这是真的。

sentences.en: The general thrust of the story is right.
sentences.zh: 报道的大体方向是正确的。

sentences.en: But you're wrong on the grand jury testimony.
sentences.zh: 但你们在大陪审团证词上搞错了。

sentences.en: You connected the dots that were not connectable.
sentences.zh: 你们把本无法串联的点串联在了一起。

sentences.en: You guys were just off when you said that Sloan testified about this to the grand jury.
sentences.zh: 你们说斯隆就此向大陪审团作证，这完全搞错了。

sentences.en: And then I finally got to Deep Throat.
sentences.zh: 然后我终于找到了“深喉”。

sentences.en: So then Woodward went to Deep Throat.
sentences.zh: 于是伍德沃德去找了“深喉”。

sentences.en: I mean, this was 3 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当时是凌晨3点。

sentences.en: I think the next day or two days later, the days rushed together.
sentences.zh: 我想是第二天或者两天后，日子过得太快，混淆了。

sentences.en: And Deep Throat told him.
sentences.zh: 然后“深喉”告诉了他。

sentences.en: When you move on somebody like Haldeman, you've got to be sure you're on the most solid ground.
sentences.zh: 当你对像霍尔德曼这样的人采取行动时，你必须确保基础极其稳固。

sentences.en: What a royal screw up, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，真是搞砸透顶了。

sentences.en: And then he said, look.
sentences.zh: 接着他说，听着。

sentences.en: The story was right.
sentences.zh: 报道是对的。

sentences.en: The whole thing.
sentences.zh: 整件事都是。

sentences.en: Watergate, all the espionage.
sentences.zh: 水门事件，所有的间谍活动。

sentences.en: It's a Haldeman operation.
sentences.zh: 这就是霍尔德曼的操作。

sentences.en: He's behind it.
sentences.zh: 他在背后主使。

sentences.en: But you guys, by getting that one fact wrong about the grand jury, have done the improbable.
sentences.zh: 但你们这帮家伙，因为在大陪审团这个事实上犯了一个错误，做了一件不可思议的事。

sentences.en: You've got people feeling sorry for Haldeman.
sentences.zh: 你们竟然让人们开始同情霍尔德曼了。

sentences.en: I didn't think that was possible.
sentences.zh: 我以前认为这根本不可能。

sentences.en: You've made people feel bad for Haldeman, one of the most disliked people in Washington.
sentences.zh: 你们让人们为霍尔德曼感到难过，他可是华盛顿最招人讨厌的人之一。

sentences.en: And one of the ringleaders of these dirty tricks with access to the slush fund, a main character in this illegal plot, the person closest to Nixon.
sentences.zh: 而且还是这些能动用秘密小金库的肮脏诡计的幕后黑手之一，这场非法阴谋中的主要角色，尼克松身边最亲近的人。

sentences.en: Mike, I'm curious what Woodward told you was the fatal error in this reporting that led to this error of the grand jury reference.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我很想知道，伍德沃德曾对你讲过，导致引用大陪审团这一错误的致命失误究竟是什么？

sentences.en: Because four sources is a lot of sources.
sentences.zh: 因为四个消息源已经不算少了。

sentences.en: There were three things.
sentences.zh: 有三件事。

sentences.en: One was that they were proceeding with confirmation bias.
sentences.zh: 第一点是他们带着确认偏误在推进调查。

sentences.en: Carla and I had heard what we wanted to hear.
sentences.zh: 卡拉和我听到了我们想听到的内容。

sentences.en: They thought the information was true.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这些信息是真的。

sentences.en: They were simply looking for sources to give them the okay to move forward with that.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在寻找消息源来给予他们继续推进的绿灯。

sentences.en: The second thing is that...
sentences.zh: 第二点是……

sentences.en: We didn't go through that process of sitting with Sloan and saying, okay, did they ask you at the grand jury about Haldeman's role?
sentences.zh: 我们没有经历坐下来跟斯隆沟通的那个过程，去问他：好吧，大陪审团有没有问过你关于霍尔德曼角色的问题？

sentences.en: They never went back to Sloan himself and walked him through exactly what they were going to be saying about his testimony.
sentences.zh: 他们从未回过头去找斯隆本人，向他逐一核对他们准备发表的关于他的证词的内容。

sentences.en: That really would have given them a chance to flush things out.
sentences.zh: 那真的会给他们一个把问题彻底弄清楚的机会。

sentences.en: Right, because he might have noticed them referring to a grand jury and he would have said, no, what you were saying is right, but I never said it to a grand jury.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为他可能会注意到他们提到了大陪审团，然后他就会说，不，你们说的方向是对的，但我从未对大陪审团这么说过。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It would have been a good way to catch it.
sentences.zh: 这本来会是一个发现问题的好方法。

sentences.en: And the third thing...
sentences.zh: 第三点……

sentences.en: The whole Bernstein, you know, silent confirm or hang up method...
sentences.zh: 整个伯恩斯坦的那种，你知道的，默默等待确认或者挂断的电话方法……

sentences.en: Is that when Bernstein, on deadline, called the Justice Department official and used this confusing way of asking him about it, that failed too.
sentences.zh: 那就是当伯恩斯坦在截稿期临近时，给司法部官员打电话，并用这种让人糊涂的方式向他询问此事，结果也失败了。

sentences.en: Everyone was just shaking their head.
sentences.zh: 每个人都只能无奈地摇头。

sentences.en: That only made everyone more ill.
sentences.zh: 那只会让所有人感到更加恶心。

sentences.en: And they missed a final opportunity to catch the mistake.
sentences.zh: 他们错失了发现这个错误的最后机会。

sentences.en: But as Woodward went back to all these sources and learned that the heart of the story was true, was he able to report that?
sentences.zh: 但当伍德沃德回访所有这些消息源并得知报道核心内容属实时，他能够把这一点报道出来吗？

sentences.en: So what they did a day or so after the story was write a piece.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在报道发表一天左右后写了一篇文章。

sentences.en: Let's level as much as we can.
sentences.zh: 让我们尽可能坦诚以待。

sentences.en: And we were able in this case to level.
sentences.zh: 而我们在这次事件中确实做到了坦诚。

sentences.en: And they said...
sentences.zh: 他们说……

sentences.en: We were wrong on the grand jury, but it was a Haldeman operation.
sentences.zh: 我们在大陪审团的问题上弄错了，但这就是霍尔德曼的一场行动。

sentences.en: That while they had gotten the grand jury part wrong, Haldeman had indeed controlled the slush fund.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们在大陪审团的部分上搞错了，但霍尔德曼确实掌控着那个秘密小金库。

sentences.en: And the general thrust of what they had reported was right.
sentences.zh: 而且他们所报道的大体方向是正确的。

sentences.en: I'm not sure it had any traction because it looked like in the beginning of 1973, Watergate might just recede, go away.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这有没有产生什么影响，因为在1973年初的时候，水门事件看起来可能会渐渐平息并消失。

sentences.en: So the story came at a critical time in the narrative because there were questions about whether this was really a story.
sentences.zh: 所以这篇报道出现在叙事发展的关键时刻，因为当时人们正质疑这到底算不算一桩真正的丑闻。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And whether we had it right.
sentences.zh: 以及我们是否搞对了。

sentences.en: The initial splash of the wrong story overshadows the important news that is right.
sentences.zh: 错误报道最初带来的轰动，掩盖了那些正确的重要新闻。

sentences.en: The thing about big stories that are big deals is that if there is a part of it that is wrong,
sentences.zh: 重大新闻的一个特点在于，如果其中某一部分是错的，

sentences.en: it allows the person who doesn't like the story to drive a Mack truck right through it.
sentences.zh: 它就会给不喜欢这篇报道的人提供一个把大卡车直接开进漏洞的机会。

sentences.en: So while they were right in terms of the narrative and arc of what was going on and what had happened
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管他们在事件的发展脉络、走向以及发生了什么、

sentences.en: and how high this went into the White House, the mistake gave the White House the excuse
sentences.zh: 以及这桩丑闻渗透到白宫多高层级这些方面是正确的，但这个失误给了白宫借口，

sentences.en: to jump on that and say, see, look, this story is wrong and all their other reporting about this is just like it.
sentences.zh: 让他们抓住不放并宣称：瞧，看吧，这篇报道是错的，他们关于这的其他所有报道也跟这一个样。

sentences.en: It's been wrong.
sentences.zh: 全都是错的。

sentences.en: I don't respect the type of journalism, the shabby journalism that is being practiced by the Washington PoSt.
sentences.zh: 我不尊重《华盛顿邮报》正在实行的这种新闻业，这种粗制滥造的新闻业。

sentences.en: And I use the term shoddy journalism, shabby journalism, and I've used the term character assassination.
sentences.zh: 我用了粗制滥造的新闻业、劣质的新闻业这些词，我还用过人格谋杀这个词。

sentences.en: What you are saying is wrong.
sentences.zh: 你们所说的是错的。

sentences.en: You have no credibility because of that.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，你们毫无公信力可言。

sentences.en: Mr. Vice President, Mrs. Agnew, all of our very distinguished guests here at the show.
sentences.zh: 副总统先生、阿格纽夫人，以及今天在现场的所有杰出嘉宾们。

sentences.en: Nixon was overwhelmingly re-elected that November.
sentences.zh: 尼克松在当年11月以压倒性优势顺利连任。

sentences.en: I've never known a national election when I would be able to go to bed earlier than tonight.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有经历过哪次全国大选，能让我比今晚更早地上床睡觉。

sentences.en: And the roots of fake news in the American discourse begin to grow.
sentences.zh: 而美国舆论场中假新闻的根源开始生根发芽。

sentences.en: That's happened to you.
sentences.zh: 这种事你也遇到过。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Happened to every reporter.
sentences.zh: 每个记者都遇到过。

sentences.en: And this is where I think that the whole discussion has been confused.
sentences.zh: 这就是我认为整个讨论被混淆的地方。

sentences.en: My observation of reporting, we all make mistakes, but the effort is good faith.
sentences.zh: 以我对报道的观察，我们都会犯错，但我们的努力是出于善意。

sentences.en: We are trying to find out what really happened in here.
sentences.zh: 我们是在试图找出这里究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: There's never a moment Carl and myself saying, well, you know, let's stretch.
sentences.zh: 我和卡尔从来没有哪个时刻会说，好吧，你知道的，让我们夸大一下吧。

sentences.en: Let's take it too far.
sentences.zh: 让我们把事情推得太远。

sentences.en: We thought we had it.
sentences.zh: 我们当时以为我们掌握了事实。

sentences.en: It was a good faith, stupid, dumbass mistake, but we made it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个出于善意的、愚蠢的、笨蛋级别的错误，但我们确实犯了。

sentences.en: Now, how much people are willing to accept good faith?
sentences.zh: 现在，人们究竟愿意在多大程度上接受这种善意？

sentences.en: There was no intent.
sentences.zh: 这并非有意为之。

sentences.en: There was no deception.
sentences.zh: 其中没有任何欺骗。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: And that's why we have to, in this era now, what, 45 years later, 46 years later, try to not make those, not make any mistake.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在这个时代的今天，距当时45年、46年之后，我们必须努力不再犯那些错误，不犯任何错误。

sentences.en: So you're saying all these decades later, this story is still in the back of your mind as you report.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，时隔几十年后的今天，在进行报道时，这篇报道依然留在你的脑海深处。

sentences.en: Indeed, it is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I've been sitting here with you.
sentences.zh: 我一直坐在这里陪着你。

sentences.en: Thank you for reliving this chapter of my life.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你陪我一起重新经历我生命中的这一章。

sentences.en: It's, you can't have that experience and it not be embedded in your head of, how could I have been so stupid and careless?
sentences.zh: 这种经历不可能不深深烙印在你的脑海里，让你忍不住去想：我怎么会这么愚蠢和粗心？

sentences.en: And I, we laid it out as best we could, but it's not a very pretty picture about being careful.
sentences.zh: 而且我，我们尽可能客观地把一切摆出来，但关于保持谨慎这件事，这实在不是一幅好看的画面。

sentences.en: I think we got everything, right?
sentences.zh: 我想我们把所有内容都涵盖了，对吧？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That was great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app, unlocked?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App，解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费体验《纽约时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间去探索付费墙背后内容，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报App，获取30天的免费访问权限吧。

sentences.en: Let's take a look at what BuzzFeed did to request comment from the special counsel.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看BuzzFeed是如何要求特别检察官置评的。

sentences.en: His first email is from Jason Leopold, the co-author of the story, sent to the special counsel's office.
sentences.zh: 他的第一封电子邮件来自报道的共同作者杰森·利奥波德，发送给特别检察官办公室。

sentences.en: It says here, Peter, hope all is well.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：彼得，希望一切都好。

sentences.en: Anthony and I have a story coming up stating that Cohen was directed by Trump himself to lie to Congress about his negotiations relating to the Trump Moscow project.
sentences.zh: 安东尼和我有一篇即将发布的报道，称特朗普本人曾指示科恩就其关于莫斯科特朗普大厦项目的谈判向国会撒谎。

sentences.en: Assume no comment from you, but just wanted to check.
sentences.zh: 假设你不会置评，但我还是想确认一下。

sentences.en: Best, Jason.
sentences.zh: 祝好，杰森。

sentences.en: Ben, to me, this is a shockingly casual way to ask for comment for such a serious story.
sentences.zh: 本，在我看来，为这样一篇严肃的报道征求意见，却用这种令人震惊的随随便便的方式。

sentences.en: Do you think that was an appropriate and sufficient way to ask for comment?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是一种恰当且充分的征求意见方式吗？

sentences.en: You know, Peter, or the spokesman for the special counsel, has told the Washington Post, I believe yesterday, or people close to him on background,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，皮特，或者说特别检察官的发言人，昨天曾对《华盛顿邮报》说过，或者说他身边的人在非正式采访中说过，

sentences.en: that if we had asked differently, he would have given us more information.
sentences.zh: 如果我们换一种方式询问，他会提供给我们更多信息。

sentences.en: But come on, one paragraph, that's a dereliction of duty to send a free sentence email to Congress.
sentences.zh: 但拜托，就一个段落，发一封只有三句话的邮件给国会，这就是失职。

sentences.en: But look, Ben, when I send emails to BuzzFeed spokespeople, and I'm about to write about you, it's a bullet point long email, everything that's going to be included.
sentences.zh: 但听着，本，当我给BuzzFeed的发言人发邮件时，当我准备写关于你的文章时，我会发一封列满要点的长邮件，把所有要收录的内容都写进去。

sentences.en: I want to make sure everything has been checked firSt.
sentences.zh: 我想确保所有内容都首先经过核实。

sentences.en: Why didn't Jason do that?
sentences.zh: 为什么杰森不那样做？

sentences.en: Carr has now said that he would have responded in more detail if he had more detail.
sentences.zh: 卡尔现在表示，如果他有更多细节，他会做出更详细的回应。

sentences.en: He could have said that two minutes later, right?
sentences.zh: 他可以在两分钟后这么说，对吧？

sentences.en: He could have said, why publish Thursday night as opposed to waiting for a third source or a fourth source, knowing the stakes of this story?
sentences.zh: 考虑到这篇报道的利害关系，他本可以问：为什么要在周四晚上发表，而不是等待第三个或第四个消息源？

sentences.en: We published because we were very, very confident in the sourcing of this story in the way that you would.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以发表，是因为我们对这篇报道的消息源有着极高、极高的信心，就像你们会做的那样。

sentences.en: And, you know, we had been waiting, right?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们已经等了很久，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it was not like Anthony walked into my office on Thursday noon and said, I have this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这并不是说安东尼在周四中午走进我的办公室说，我掌握了这个。

sentences.en: This is a story we've been developing over a long period of time that we've been working on with sources.
sentences.zh: 这是我们经过很长时间不断推进、并与消息源共同打造的一篇报道。

sentences.en: Mike, why did this story that Woodward told you remind you of the BuzzFeed story?
sentences.zh: 迈克，为什么伍德沃德跟你讲过的这个故事会让你想起BuzzFeed的报道？

sentences.en: Because in both cases, they were really reporting two things.
sentences.zh: 因为在这两种情况下，他们实际上都在报道两件事。

sentences.en: One was the existence of the information.
sentences.zh: 一是该信息的存在。

sentences.en: In the BuzzFeed story, it's the fact that Cohen said Trump asked him to lie to Congress.
sentences.zh: 在BuzzFeed的报道中，事实是科恩说特朗普要求他向国会撒谎。

sentences.en: The second thing they were reporting is that investigators knew about it.
sentences.zh: 他们报道的第二件事是调查人员已经知道了这一点。

sentences.en: It was the same situation that Woodward found himself in because they had reported that Sloan knew about the slush fund and that Holdeman controlled it.
sentences.zh: 这与伍德沃德当时的处境如出一辙，因为他们曾报道斯隆知道秘密金流，并且霍尔德曼控制着它。

sentences.en: And he had told it to the grand jury.
sentences.zh: 而且他已经把这件事告诉了大陪审团。

sentences.en: The fact that the investigators knew about it gave the fact validity.
sentences.zh: 调查人员知道这一事实，赋予了该事实有效性。

sentences.en: It said this is not just something that's floating out there that we figured out on our own.
sentences.zh: 这说明这不仅仅是我们自己琢磨出来的、凭空飘浮的东西。

sentences.en: This is something that the people investigating the president have figured out.
sentences.zh: 这是调查总统的人已经查明的事情。

sentences.en: If you don't have the validity, the backing of investigators knowing it, the reporting at times feels shakier.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有这种有效性，没有调查人员知情作背书，报道有时就会显得不够稳固。

sentences.en: Right, which is why the moment BuzzFeed reported that Mueller knew Trump had done this is when Democrats in the House and the Senate were saying,
sentences.zh: 没错，这就是为什么当BuzzFeed报道说穆勒知道特朗普做过这件事时，参众两院的民主党人纷纷表示，

sentences.en: we have to act, this is the moment to impeach the president.
sentences.zh: 我们必须采取行动，现在就是弹劾总统的时刻。

sentences.en: Yes, but it was the second part that they didn't have locked down that undercut them in their reporting, in the story.
sentences.zh: 是的，但正是他们没有锁定的第二部分，削弱了他们在报道和故事中的说服力。

sentences.en: It allowed the White House to attack them.
sentences.zh: 这给了白宫攻击他们的口实。

sentences.en: So when the public finds out that the second part is not true, that the investigators do not know this, it negates the primary fact that they were reporting on.
sentences.zh: 因此，当公众发现第二部分并非事实、调查人员并不了解这一点时，这就否定了他们所报道的核心事实。

sentences.en: Right, and that's why when the second part is challenged, the first part is so fundamentally undermined.
sentences.zh: 没错，这就是为什么当第二部分受到质疑时，第一部分就会从根本上被动摇。

sentences.en: The first part no longer feels like it can be true if the second part also isn't true.
sentences.zh: 如果第二部分也不是真的，第一部分就会让人觉得不再可能是真的。

sentences.en: They're highly linked.
sentences.zh: 它们紧密相连。

sentences.en: Right, but what will ultimately matter is whether the fact they were bringing forward that Trump asked Cohen to lie to Congress is true.
sentences.zh: 对，但最终起决定作用的，还是他们提出的“特朗普要求科恩向国会撒谎”这一事实是否属实。

sentences.en: That will be the most important thing.
sentences.zh: 这将是最重要的事情。

sentences.en: When Woodward is in the middle of it and he made this mistake, he thought he was going to have to resign.
sentences.zh: 当伍德沃德身处风口浪尖且犯下这个错误时，他曾以为自己不得不辞职。

sentences.en: The public turned on him.
sentences.zh: 公众背弃了他。

sentences.en: The White House went after him.
sentences.zh: 白宫对展开了对他的围剿。

sentences.en: Now, looking back on that, that seems ridiculous to imagine because most of us don't even remember that mistake.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，这似乎荒谬得难以想象，因为我们大多数人甚至都不记得那个错误了。

sentences.en: His reporting on Watergate is remembered as heroic and historic, but that's because of how the investigation ended.
sentences.zh: 他对水门事件的报道被铭记为英雄般的历史壮举，但这归功于调查最终的结局。

sentences.en: We're sort of back in that situation now with the BuzzFeed story.
sentences.zh: 我们现在某种程度上又回到了BuzzFeed报道所处的那种境地。

sentences.en: Will it be proven out that Trump asked Cohen to lie and that be a central part of the Trump story?
sentences.zh: 事实最终会证明特朗普确实要求科恩撒谎，并使其成为特朗普丑闻的核心部分吗？

sentences.en: If so, the BuzzFeed reporters will be looked at as being at the front of this and really have uncovered important information.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，BuzzFeed的记者将被视为走在时代前沿，真正发掘了重要信息。

sentences.en: Right, and their errors seeming very small.
sentences.zh: 没错，而且他们的错误看起来会微不足道。

sentences.en: Right, but if history doesn't go in that direction,
sentences.zh: 对，但如果历史没有朝着那个方向发展，

sentences.en: it will be a story that critics and defenders of Trump will point to in the years to come as examples of the media going too far as it tried to cover the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这将成为未来几年特朗普的批评者和捍卫者津津乐道的故事，作为媒体在试图报道调查时走得太远的典型例证。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is right now it's too early to know if the BuzzFeed reporting is what Woodward's mistake ultimately turned out to be.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，现在断言BuzzFeed的报道最终是否会沦为伍德沃德当年那样的错误，还为时过早。

sentences.en: A small factual error along the way when the big picture of the reporting is accurate.
sentences.zh: 这究竟只是报道宏观大局准确无误过程中的一个小事实错误，

sentences.en: Or a sign that what the media thinks might be true, what the president would argue the media perhaps wants to be true, is not in fact what the investigators have found.
sentences.zh: 还是一个迹象，表明媒体认为可能是真的、或者总统会辩称媒体或许希望它是真的事情，实际上并非调查人员所发现的那样。

sentences.en: And the problem is that the public wants an answer now.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，公众现在就想要一个答案。

sentences.en: And usually that takes a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 而这通常需要大量的时间。

sentences.en: As Woodward often says, it takes a long time for history to be sussed out.
sentences.zh: 正如伍德沃德经常说的那样，历史需要很长时间才能厘清。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: One day after his own intelligence chiefs contradicted him on the threats posed by Iran, North Korea, and ISIS,
sentences.zh: 就在情报部门负责人就伊朗、朝鲜和ISIS构成的威胁与他意见相左的一天之后，

sentences.en: President Trump lashed out at them in a series of tweets, questioning their intellect.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在一系列推文中对他们进行了猛烈抨击，质疑他们的智商。

sentences.en: The president wrote that the officials, including the heads of the CIA and the FBI, are, quote, naive and passive, especially about the dangers of Iran and North Korea,
sentences.zh: 总统写道，包括中情局和联邦调查局局长在内的官员“既天真又被动，尤其是在面对伊朗和朝鲜的危险时”，

sentences.en: and suggested that, quote, perhaps intelligence should go back to school.
sentences.zh: 并暗示“或许情报部门应该回学校重新进修”。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday, local police said that the deep freeze that has settled over the Midwest has killed at least eight people,
sentences.zh: 周三，当地警方表示，席卷中西部的极寒天气已经导致至少八人死亡，

sentences.en: including some who froze to death after exposure to the cold from Milwaukee to Detroit.
sentences.zh: 其中有些人是从密尔沃基到底特律因暴露在严寒中而冻死。

sentences.en: The record low temperatures in cities like Minneapolis and Chicago reached minus 28 degrees, with a wind chill of minus 53, resulting in widespread flight cancellations,
sentences.zh: 明尼阿波利斯和芝加哥等城市的创纪录低温达到了零下28华氏度（约零下33摄氏度），风寒效应更是达到零下53华氏度（约零下47摄氏度），导致该地区大面积航班取消、

sentences.en: school closures, and even the suspension of mail delivery throughout the region.
sentences.zh: 学校停课，甚至暂停了整个地区的邮件投递。

sentences.en: It's evaporating.
sentences.zh: 它正在蒸发。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们正为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在你家宾至如归的妙招。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一沾枕头就睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会喝断片来睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症、饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是爱喝咖啡还是爱喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索收听《Wirecutter秀》。
